_comment: Premises ladder. Nothing is locked by tier — only cost. move_fee is a one-off (removals + deposit). floor_m2/power_kw are soft limits shown in the Building app. scene = the playable level.

buildings.name: Home garage
buildings.blurb: Uncle's garage. Damp in the corner, oil on the floor, kettle that works. It's a start.

buildings.name: Lock-up unit
buildings.blurb: Double-width lock-up in a gated court. Twice the floor space, a proper roller door and nobody's bike in the way.

buildings.name: Small industrial unit
buildings.blurb: Modern terraced unit on a tidy estate: 6 m eaves, roof lights, a front office and your name on the fascia.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.blurb: Standalone 9 m warehouse with three dock levellers, a secure yard and a two-storey office.

buildings.name: Distribution centre
buildings.blurb: Eight dock doors, HGV yard, gatehouse, sprinkler tank and a glass office block. Serious kit for a serious operation.

buildings.name: Refurb facility
buildings.blurb: Purpose-built flagship: glazed atrium HQ, colour-zoned production floor, mezzanine, solar roof and a visitor plaza.

buildings.name: Mega plant
buildings.blurb: A campus. Sawtooth-roofed super-hall, sixteen docks, HQ tower, solar car ports and its own wind turbine. Robots welcome.
